# Yellow arms moved back down to previous position. So UP moved them up 3 rows, DOWN moved them back down.
# Maybe the goal is to align the yellow arms with yellow tokens in gray squares? Let's map token positions.
frame = current_frame
squares = [n for n in frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='c' and n['pixels']==8]
tokens = []
for sq in squares:
    child = next(n for n in frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['id']==sq['children'][0])
    # token position: maybe center of square? Use boundary of child
    rows = [p[0] for p in child['boundary']]
    cols = [p[1] for p in child['boundary']]
    tokens.append({'color':child['color'],'row':sum(rows)//len(rows),'col':sum(cols)//len(cols),'sq_id':sq['id']})
print(tokens)
# Yellow arms positions
yellow_arms = [n for n in frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='Y' and n['pixels']>=10]
for n in yellow_arms:
    rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
    cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
    print('arm id',n['id'],'center', (sum(rows)//len(rows), sum(cols)//len(cols)))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

# Left moved yellow arms left by 3 cols.
# So the broken cross's arms move together as a whole? Actually all four arms moved left 3 cols.
# So UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT move the broken cross (yellow) as a rigid shape.
# Goal maybe to align arms with tokens? Let's see distance between arms centers and tokens.
frame = current_frame
# tokens
squares = [n for n in frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='c' and n['pixels']==8]
tokens=[]
for sq in squares:
    child = next(n for n in frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['id']==sq['children'][0])
    rows=[p[0] for p in child['boundary']]
    cols=[p[1] for p in child['boundary']]
    tokens.append({'color':child['color'],'row':sum(rows)//len(rows),'col':sum(cols)//len(cols)})
# yellow arms
arms=[]
for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
    if n['color']=='Y' and n['pixels']>=10:
        rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
        cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
        arms.append({'id':n['id'],'row':sum(rows)//len(rows),'col':sum(cols)//len(cols)})
print('arms', arms)
print('tokens', tokens)

# We have 3 squares with tokens: (3,15),(9,6),(17,15). The square at (9,24) seems lost its token? Maybe token was collected?
# Let's check previous frame tokens.
prev=last_transition.before_frame
prev_squares=[n for n in prev.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='c' and n.get('children')]
tokens_prev=[]
for sq in prev_squares:
    child_id=sq['children'][0]
    child=next(n for n in prev.segmentation['nodes'] if n['id']==child_id)
    rows=[p[0] for p in sq['boundary']]
    cols=[p[1] for p in sq['boundary']]
    tokens_prev.append({'row':sum(rows)//len(rows),'col':sum(cols)//len(cols)})
print(tokens_prev)

nodes=current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
blue_nodes=[n for n in nodes if n['color']=='b']
print('blue nodes count', len(blue_nodes))
# Find big blue cross: maybe several connected nodes? Let's check adjacency.
adj=current_frame.segmentation['adjacency_list']
# Build component.
from collections import defaultdict, deque
graph=defaultdict(list)
for i,j in adj:
    graph[i].append(j)
    graph[j].append(i)
visited=set()
components=[]
for n in blue_nodes:
    nid=n['id']
    if nid in visited: continue
    q=deque([nid])
    visited.add(nid)
    comp=[]
    while q:
        cur=q.popleft()
        comp.append(cur)
        for nb in graph[cur]:
            if nb not in visited and any(x['id']==nb for x in blue_nodes):
                visited.add(nb)
                q.append(nb)
    components.append(comp)
print('blue components', len(components))
for comp in components:
    ids=comp
    rows=[]
    cols=[]

        node=next(n for n in nodes if n['id']==nid)
        rows.extend([p[0] for p in node['boundary']])
        cols.extend([p[1] for p in node['boundary']])
    print('comp size', len(ids), sum(rows)//len(rows), sum(cols)//len(cols))
